items.title: Cisco raises AI outlook as infrastructure demand accelerates
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi welcomes Cisco (CSCO) CFO Mark Patterson to discuss the company’s latest earnings, investor concerns, and Cisco’s updated full-year AI outlook. Cisco is forecasting continued strength in AI infrastructure demand, with FY2027 AI infrastructure revenue expected to reach $7.5 billion.
